entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Any progress with the Phantom Thieves?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Calling card...?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Huh? HUH?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: There's something written on it...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: "Thanks for your support.[n]Please help those in need."

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: "This is a promise to you[n]from the Phantom Thieves:"

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: "We're going to post a secret message,[n]just for you, on the game's official[n]website."

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Is... Is this for real?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I mean, you can probably just buy one of these[n]cards at the store...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: The official Gun About website?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Whoa! The mark of the Phantom Thieves![n]They hacked the site!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Just like they did on Medjed's site!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Which means... you were able to contact[n]the real Phantom Thieves! No way!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: How'd you do it?
Through a secret exchange.
Through a bulletin board.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: That's so cool... So they want to remain[n]anonymous...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Huh? That's all you had to do? Oh, right,[n]that way their true identities stay hidden...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Wow, I can't believe they sent me a[n]message...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I wasn't expecting much from you,[n][lName]-san, but you're actually[n]pretty cool.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I wish I was able to talk with[n]them or something though...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But you fulfilled your part of the deal,[n]so I'll teach you how to shoot.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Once you stop them from[n]moving, you gotta hit their[n]weak point right away.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You should be able to inflict a lot of[n]damage to the cheater this way.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Let's get started.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...C'mon, you gotta aim.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...No, no, no. You're just stopping their[n]movement by doing that.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Ugh! No! Not like that!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Are you taking this seriously!?[n]You gotta focus on your second[n]shot!
He's almost like a different[n]person when he gets mad.
His instructions are precise,[n]but also spartan-like...

entries.speaker: Arcade Spectator
entries.en: The King's swearing up a storm today...

entries.speaker: Loud Spectator
entries.en: That's what happens when he teams up[n]with another player.

entries.speaker: Loud Spectator
entries.en: And why everyone also watches him[n]from a distance...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...All right, looks like you kinda got[n]the hang of it.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I think you'll be able to beat[n]that cheater now.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I have a bad habit of swearing when I[n]get all worked up...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Sorry.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But I think you have a lot of potential.[n]More than most people!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: If you want... I can teach you a few[n]other moves too!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I have the ultimate trump card.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: So tell me more about the Phantom[n]Thieves!
It's a deal.
Leave it to me.
Depends on the trump card.
I've made a deal with Shinya...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...According to the reports, it seems[n]your skill at handling a gun is quite[n]impressive.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Either you taught yourself... or you[n]had a capable coach by your side...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Where did you learn how to handle[n]a gun!?

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: You have agreed to a new contract.[n]Excellent.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Your gun expertise shall increase[n]through this new bond of yours.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...It's earlier than usual today.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I gotta go. See ya later!
